title: Build Central Shared Parameter Registry from Existing TXT Sources
purpose: Create or update the governed central Shared Parameter Registry from one or more existing shared-parameter TXT sources using GUID-first identity, provenance capture, Citizen/Visitor classification, and explicit collision handling.

applies_to.scope: Shared-parameter source consolidation and registry maintenance

preconditions: Source TXT files are available in a controlled workspace and their project, discipline, or environment provenance can be identified.
A governed central Shared Parameter Registry location exists.
GUID-first identity and Citizen/Visitor governance are understood and applicable.

steps.name: Stage source TXT files
actions: Collect the shared-parameter TXT sources in a controlled workspace.
Record source provenance for each input file.
validation: Every staged source has traceable provenance.

steps.name: Parse parameters using GUID-first identity
actions: Extract each parameter GUID, name, group identifier, and data type from the TXT source.
Capture semantic group name where available.
Normalize only obvious whitespace or typographic defects that do not change meaning; otherwise flag the discrepancy for governance.
validation: Every observed parameter retains its source GUID and structural definition.
failure_modes: A source parameter cannot be parsed reliably.
A proposed normalization could change semantic meaning.

steps.name: Build composite observed set
actions: Union parsed parameters into a composite working set keyed by GUID.
Retain all observed source files for each GUID.
Flag repeated names under different GUIDs as potential collisions.
validation: Each unique GUID is represented once in the composite set.
failure_modes: A name collision is silently merged.

steps.name: Classify Citizen, Visitor, and lifecycle status
actions: Apply governed Citizen/Visitor rules to each observed parameter.
Use Active only for confirmed governed Citizens.
Use Candidate for items pending review and Deprecated for identities being retired.
validation: Every registry row has an explicit lane and status.
Unresolved items are not silently promoted to Active Citizen status.
failure_modes: Classification is inferred without governance support.
A Visitor or unresolved candidate is treated as a governed Citizen.

steps.name: Populate governed registry
actions: Create one registry row per unique GUID.
Populate GUID, Name, GroupId, GroupName, DataType, DataCategory where applicable, Lane, Status, SourceFiles, and Notes.
Preserve exact GUID, name, group, and data-type fidelity for governed Citizen parameters unless a separately governed change is approved.
validation: Registry identity and structural fields match the governed source decisions.
failure_modes: A GUID or structural field is modified without governed change control.

steps.name: Validate registry integrity
actions: Check completeness against all staged sources.
Resolve or explicitly record repeated names under distinct GUIDs.
Record collision decisions in registry notes and lifecycle state.
validation: Every staged parameter is represented as Citizen or Visitor.
Every known collision has an explicit governed disposition.
failure_modes: Parameters are omitted from the registry.

outputs: Governed GUID-first Shared Parameter Registry update
governance_notes: The governed registry is the authority for shared-parameter identity; source TXT files are evidence inputs, not competing authorities.
Seed/example rows in the source do not create new canonical registry entries beyond those separately migrated and governed.
Meaning-changing normalization requires governed review rather than silent cleanup.

provenance.source_title: Instruction Set for Building a Central Shared Parameter Registry
provenance.migration_note: Source is draft L6 guidance. Organization-specific labels and source filenames were neutralized; the GUID-first registry procedure and governance boundaries were preserved.
